propositions: Five test modules repeatedly construct equivalent virgin git/rebar store topologies from scratch for each test consumer, contributing 103.416 aggregate worker-seconds of avoidable setup overhead across 260 fixture_setup spans.

Runtime instrumentation demonstrated real-build versus isolated-copy time ratios of approximately 12x to 23x across the five modules, confirming that setup time rather than test-body work dominates the measured fixture spans.

The clone_topology_template helper initially failed to remint asymmetric op-cert signing keys (.opcert-key/.opcert-key.pub), violating isolation contracts and causing clones with distinct environment identities to authenticate using shared private key material.

Migrating proven-equivalent fixtures to session-scoped templates with per-test isolation copies reduces setup overhead without removing any tests, assertions, or from-scratch initialization/recovery contracts.
Isolation sentinels must validate that per-test copies do not share ticket refs, linked-worktree paths, gate snapshots, environment IDs, signing keys, module caches, or mutable config state.
